mostWorthwhile.text: Holding the glass was most worthwhile because the slipping example brought touch, nerves and muscle work together in an understandable action.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the surface cells and adding their outer layer felt predictable, though the resulting descriptions explained what each layer contributed.

surprise.text: The distinction between dead outer skin cells and the living layers that replace them changed how I thought about the protective surface.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt especially arbitrary; the item names and descriptions suggested how the skin parts fit together.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it offered a similarly concrete action to explain. The final feedback sequence was more engaging than assembling layers alone.
